mapper.select: SELECT it.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec, m.unit, sp.name AS supplier_name, o.status AS order_status, COALESCE(arr.qty, 0) AS arrived_qty FROM ecom_purchase_plan_item it LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = it.material_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier sp ON sp.id = it.supplier_id LEFT JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = it.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT oi.order_id, oi.material_id, SUM(oi.done_qty) AS qty FROM scm_order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id IN (SELECT x.order_id FROM ecom_purchase_plan_item x WHERE x.plan_id = #{planId} AND x.order_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY oi.order_id, oi.material_id) arr ON arr.order_id = it.order_id AND arr.material_id = it.material_id WHERE it.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY it.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ecom_purchase_plan_item (plan_id, material_id, suggest_qty, qty, supplier_id, price, tax_rate, arrival_date, demand, order_id, order_no, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.planId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.suggestQty}, #{i.qty}, #{i.supplierId}, #{i.price}, #{i.taxRate}, #{i.arrivalDate}, #{i.demand}, #{i.orderId}, #{i.orderNo}, #{i.remark}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
